audit.why: 55.63% WR over 915 games for Naafiri — strongly favoured. Immobile scaling mage with no escape ultimate; packet chart gives Naafiri every stage. EVEN 5.5/10 is arguably generous to Ryze but within tolerance.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart gave Ryze first item and 2+ items and 'Skill' at 4-5 and 6, while content and packet give Naafiri all seven stages — and the whys under the Ryze rows described Naafiri winning.
audit.why: Ryze needs multiple items plus mana stacking to come online; his W only roots after E's Flux lands, his R is a repositioning tool not a combat save, and Naafiri spikes a full item earlier.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to Naafiri with matching ratings and rewritten whys where the verdict text was wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly called Ryze's root the 'E-Q root' — the root is W Rune Prison, and it only roots when E's Flux is on the target, so the chain is E-W; E-Q is his damage combo. It also referenced a Ryze 'shield' twice — current-kit Ryze has none. Naafiri's dash again miscredited to W ('W (The Pack Hunts)', 'W-E onto', 'W-E-pack combo').
audit.why: Kit text: W 'if the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted'; W runs 11s down to 9, E 3.5s down to 2.5, Q a 5s reset loop.
audit.corrected: E-Q root corrected to E-W everywhere, shield claims removed, W/R slots fixed, real cooldowns written.
